# Copilot Instructions

This repository is a master's thesis research project.

- Never fabricate experimental results, metrics, charts, citations, or conclusions.
- Prevent data leakage and keep all preprocessing inside scikit-learn pipelines.
- Do not modify raw data in place.
- Use the final test set only once for a given experiment.
- Add tests for behavioral changes.
- Run Ruff and pytest before considering a task complete.
- Document scientific and implementation assumptions explicitly.
- Prefer reproducible, readable implementations over unnecessary complexity.
- Distinguish implemented functionality, planned functionality, assumptions, and actual findings.
